provenance.basis: same flavour as the single repeated filler sentence in fork/research/scripts/bench_long_context.py (FILLER), but expanded to 30 distinct sentences so repeated filler is not a single memorisable string
provenance.note: Deliberately contains no digits and no support-domain vocabulary, so (a) filler cannot answer the question and (b) every digit in a document comes from the needle. This is stricter than upstream's filler, which also had no digits.
